label: Which endpoint lists a dated (future) scheduled post

facts.question: ticket 136: does GET /schedules/later/post list a post scheduled for a future date?
facts.answer: no. A dated scheduled post appears only in GET /schedules (date-range calendar). GET /schedules/later/post returned an empty list while one dated post was scheduled.
facts.schedules_read: GET /api2/v2/schedules?limit=10&filter[publishDate]={today}&filter[publishDateEnd]={today+1y}&filter[timeZone]={tz} -> 200 {list: 1 item, syncInProcess}; item type post, publishDateTime set (5 days ahead), createdDateTime months earlier, entity = the post (same entity shape as later/post)
facts.paging: GET /schedules has no paging: limit and offset are both ignored. Answer keys are only list + syncInProcess (no hasMore, no total, no cursor). GET /schedules/later/post does carry hasMore. A client must page /schedules by date range (publishDate/publishDateEnd), not by offset.
facts.queue_page_read: the Queue page (/my/queue) itself reads GET /schedules?limit=4 with publishDate today .. today+1y and the browser time zone
facts.existing_post: the dated post was already on the account (not created by this read, not an oi- marker post); nothing was scheduled, so no write and no undo
facts.reader: OFClient signed GETs with the relay-session copy of the Proof Creator's capture-browser session, plus one Queue page load in the capture browser
facts.access: ticket 136 read: GET only. Paging follow-up: 1 scheduled-post create + 1 delete on the Proof Creator sandbox (D25), undone
facts.offset_honoured: no, offset is ignored. With 2 dated posts in today..today+40d, limit=1&offset=0 and limit=1&offset=1 both returned the same 2 items in the same order.
facts.limit_honoured: no for limit=1: it returned 2 items, on 2 different days. Per-day vs fully ignored was not separated (only 1 post per day). The date range is honoured: today..today+10d returned only the item inside it.
facts.limit_100: accepted: 200, returned every item in the range (2 with the marker post, 1 after the undo). No error, no cap seen.
facts.item_types_seen: post only (the range had no scheduled chats)
facts.scheduled_create_body:
OF's composer schedules a post with POST /api2/v2/posts {text (

-wrapped), preview [], rfTag [], rfGuest [], rfPartner [], isScheduled 1, scheduledDate ISO UTC with ms}. The post stays unpublished and shows up in /schedules with publishDateTime = scheduledDate.
facts.paging_reads: OFClient signed GET /api2/v2/schedules with filter[publishDate]={today}, filter[publishDateEnd]={today+40d}, filter[timeZone]={tz}: (a) limit=1&offset=0, (b) limit=1&offset=1, (c) limit=100, (d) limit=10. All 4 returned 200 with the identical 2-item list.
facts.undo: the oi-136-paging marker post (scheduled +20d, never published) was deleted with DELETE /api2/v2/posts/{post id} -> 200 success. /schedules re-read: 1 item, only the pre-existing post. Logged in sitting UNDO-LOG part 4.
